title: Ed Walters, the Model and Tommy Smith

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Chris (i.e., Tommy Smith), do you know...probably the most famous shot of all, this is that one out over the road on Sound Side Drive. Do you know how that picture was done?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Yes, Ed said he had a lot of trouble with that one. He just fabricated it like all the other ones...double exposure.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Do you know how he illuminated the roadway?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: Illuminated the roadway? Okay, I would have to see the photograph, to be sure.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: If I can refresh your memory a little but, it was the one over the road on Sound Side Drive, and not only was the object there, but there was a bright light reflecting onto the middle of the roadway.

segments.speaker: GrayEd
segments.text: And the light looked like it was emanating from the object that's hovering over the road.

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: No, I don't think I could help you there, for sure.

segments.speaker: interviewer
segments.text: Do you know if Ed had help on that picture, or did he do that one alone?

segments.speaker: interviewee
segments.text: I couldn't answer that honestly either.
